business_scenario: Support-operations ticket export used by internal dashboards.

amount_outliers.business_risk: Extreme values can skew reporting and need review before publication.

duplicate_primary_keys.business_risk: Dashboards can double-count a support case or attach remediation to the wrong row.

missing_routing_fields.business_risk: Support operations cannot reliably route or prioritize every ticket.

negative_amounts.business_risk: Refund-like events are mixed into positive customer-impact facts.

not_claimed: No customer production deployment is claimed.
This artifact measures a reproducible business-data case study, not enterprise adoption.
resume_safe_summary: Quantified 4 support-ticket data quality issue categories across 8 rows, including duplicate ticket IDs, missing routing fields, negative amounts, and amount outliers.

top_root_cause_hypotheses.recommended_action: Separate refunds, credits, and exceptional values from standard fact tables or annotate them explicitly.
top_root_cause_hypotheses.title: Business-rule validation is not separating exceptional transactions from standard facts.

top_root_cause_hypotheses.recommended_action: Add idempotent merge logic and enforce a uniqueness check on the primary key.
top_root_cause_hypotheses.title: The ingestion pipeline may be replaying events without idempotent merge logic.

top_root_cause_hypotheses.recommended_action: Trace null generation for affected fields through the source API and transform layer.
top_root_cause_hypotheses.title: Source API or transform logic is producing incomplete fields for required analytics columns.
